mapper.select: SELECT A.file_mapp_seq , A.office_seq , A.tbl_seq , A.file_seq , A.doc_seq , D.doc_nm AS docName , A.file_kind_code , A.file_category_code , A.note /* 파일명 가져오기 (utb_file_mst에 파일명 컬럼이 있다고 가정, 만약 없다면 정확한 컬럼명으로 교체 필요) */ , B.file_original_nm AS fileName /* URL 조합: repository_url + '/' + file_nm */ , CONCAT(C.repository_url, '/', B.file_nm) AS downloadUrl ,file_display_size , A.create_user , A.create_at FROM utb_file_mapp A LEFT JOIN utb_file_mst B ON A.file_seq = B.file_seq AND B.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_file_repository C ON B.file_repository_seq = C.file_repository_seq AND C.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_document_mst D ON A.doc_seq::integer = D.doc_seq WHERE A.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND A.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND A.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY A.create_at DESC

SELECT MAX(A.file_mapp_seq) AS file_mapp_seq , A.office_seq , A.tbl_seq , MAX(A.file_seq) AS file_seq , A.doc_seq , fn_get_cd_nm('DOC_TYPE_CD', A.doc_seq) AS doc_name , A.file_kind_code , fn_get_cd_nm('DOC_TYPE_CD', A.file_kind_code) AS file_kind_name , A.file_category_code , A.input_create_at , A.note , string_agg(B.file_original_nm, ', ' ORDER BY B.file_seq) AS fileName , string_agg(B.file_seq, ',' ORDER BY B.file_seq) AS fileSeqs , MAX(CONCAT(C.repository_url, '/', B.file_nm)) AS downloadUrl , CAST(SUM(CAST(B.file_size AS numeric)) AS varchar) AS file_display_size , D.user_name_ko FROM utb_file_mapp A LEFT JOIN utb_file_mst B ON A.file_seq = B.file_seq AND B.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_file_repository C ON B.file_repository_seq = C.file_repository_seq AND C.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_user_info D ON A.create_user = D.user_info_seq WHERE A.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND A.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND A.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY A.office_seq, A.tbl_seq, A.doc_seq, A.file_kind_code, A.file_category_code, A.input_create_at, A.note, D.user_name_ko ORDER BY A.input_create_at DESC, MAX(A.create_at) DESC

SELECT file_mapp_seq , office_seq , tbl_seq , file_seq , doc_seq , file_kind_code , file_category_code , note , create_user , create_at FROM utb_file_mapp WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY create_at DESC

SELECT A.file_mapp_seq , A.office_seq , A.tbl_seq , A.file_seq , A.doc_seq , fn_get_cd_nm('DOC_TYPE_CD', A.doc_seq) AS doc_name
, A.file_kind_code , fn_get_cd_nm('DOC_TYPE_CD', A.file_kind_code) AS file_kind_name , A.file_category_code , A.input_create_at , A.note , B.file_original_nm AS fileName , CONCAT(C.repository_url, '/', B.file_nm) AS downloadUrl ,file_display_size , D.user_name_ko , A.create_user , A.create_at , A.update_user , A.update_at , A.note FROM utb_file_mapp A LEFT JOIN utb_file_mst B ON A.file_seq = B.file_seq AND B.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_file_repository C ON B.file_repository_seq = C.file_repository_seq AND C.del_yn = 'N' AND C.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_user_info D ON A.create_user = D.user_info_seq WHERE A.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND A.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND A.del_yn = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM utb_file_mapp X WHERE X.file_mapp_seq = #{fileMappSeq} AND X.office_seq = A.office_seq AND X.tbl_seq = A.tbl_seq AND X.doc_seq = A.doc_seq AND X.file_kind_code = A.file_kind_code AND COALESCE(X.note, '') = COALESCE(A.note, '') AND (X.input_create_at = A.input_create_at OR (X.input_create_at IS NULL AND A.input_create_at IS NULL)) )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification) AS "caseClassificationCode" , fn_get_cd_nm('CASE_CLASSIFICATION', COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification)) AS "caseClassificationName" /* 사건구분 */ , fn_get_dossier_category_code(COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification), fmap.tbl_seq) AS "caseCategoryCode" , fn_get_dossier_category_code(COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification), fmap.tbl_seq) AS "dossierCategory" , fn_get_cd_nm('DOSSIER_CATEGORY', fn_get_dossier_category_code(COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification), fmap.tbl_seq)) AS "caseCategoryName" /* 구분 */ , parent_map.parent_seq AS "parentSeq" , fmap.tbl_seq AS "tblSeq" , uam.app_route AS "appRoute" , fn_get_cd_nm('IP_PROC_TYPE', uam.app_route) as "appRouteName" , uam.right_category AS "rightCategoryCode" , fn_get_cd_nm('PAT_TYPE', uam.right_category) as "rightCategoryName" /* 권리 */ , uam.asset_no AS "assetNo" , uam.asset_no AS "ourRef" /* ★ MyBatis 조건절과 맞춤 */ , uam.app_no AS "appNo" , uam.reg_no AS "regNo" , MAX(fmst.file_seq) AS "fileSeq" , fmap.doc_seq AS "docSeq" , fn_get_doc_nm(fmap.doc_seq) AS "docName" , fn_get_cd_nm('DOC_TYPE_CD', fmap.file_kind_code) AS "productClass" /* 분류 */ , fn_get_doc_nm(fmap.doc_seq) AS "content" /* 내용 */ , fmap.file_kind_code AS "fileKindCode" , fmap.file_kind_code AS "attachDocDiv" , MAX(fmst.file_nm) AS "fileNm" , string_agg(fmst.file_original_nm, ', ' ORDER BY fmst.file_seq) AS "fileOriginalName" , string_agg(fmst.file_original_nm, ', ' ORDER BY fmst.file_seq) AS "fileName" , string_agg(fmst.file_seq, ',' ORDER BY fmst.file_seq) AS "fileSeqs" , MAX(CONCAT(frepo.repository_url, '/', fmst.file_nm)) AS "downloadUrl" , CAST(SUM(CAST(fmst.file_size AS numeric)) AS varchar) AS "fileDisplaySize" , uui.user_info_seq AS "uploadUserSeq" , uui.user_name_ko AS "uploadUserName" , fmap.note AS "note" , fmap.note AS "fileSummary" , fmap.input_create_at AS "docDate" , MAX(fmst.create_at) AS "uploadDate" , MAX(fmst.create_at) AS "createAt" , CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS "regDate" , uui.user_name_ko AS "createUserName" , uam.right_category AS "rightTypeCode" , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS "deptName" , uam.app_route AS "appRouteCode" FROM utb_file_mapp fmap INNER JOIN utb_file_mst fmst ON fmst.file_seq = fmap.file_seq AND fmst.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_file_repository frepo ON fmst.file_repository_seq = frepo.file_repository_seq AND frepo.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT design_seq AS child_seq, app_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_app_design WHERE del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT patent_seq AS child_seq, app_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_app_patent WHERE del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT trademark_seq AS child_seq, app_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_app_trademark WHERE del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT progress_seq AS child_seq, tbl_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_progress WHERE del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT uem.app_ext_seq AS child_seq, uem.app_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_ext_mapp uem INNER JOIN utb_app_ext_mst uaem ON uaem.app_ext_seq = uem.app_ext_seq AND uaem.del_yn = 'N' WHERE uem.del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT umm.memo_seq AS child_seq, umm.tbl_seq AS parent_seq FROM utb_memo_mapp umm INNER JOIN utb_memo um ON um.memo_seq = umm.memo_seq AND um.del_yn = 'N' WHERE umm.del_yn = 'N' ) parent_map ON parent_map.child_seq = fmap.tbl_seq LEFT JOIN utb_app_mst uam ON uam.app_seq = COALESCE(parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq) AND uam.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_user_info uui ON uui.user_info_seq = fmap.create_user LEFT JOIN utb_customer uc ON uc.customer_seq = COALESCE(parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq) AND uc.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_conflict_mst ucm ON ucm.conflict_seq = COALESCE(parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq) AND ucm.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_invoice_mst uim ON uim.invoice_seq = COALESCE(parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq) AND uim.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_app_ext_mst uaem ON uaem.app_ext_seq = COALESCE(parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq) AND uaem.del_yn = 'N' WHERE fmap.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND fmap.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(uam.app_seq, uc.customer_seq, ucm.conflict_seq, uim.invoice_seq, uaem.app_ext_seq) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(uam.case_classification, uc.case_classification, ucm.case_classification, uim.case_classification, uaem.case_classification), uui.user_info_seq, uui.user_name_ko, parent_map.parent_seq, fmap.tbl_seq, uam.app_route, uam.right_category, uam.asset_no, uam.app_no, uam.reg_no, fmap.doc_seq, fmap.file_kind_code, fmap.note, fmap.input_create_at ) AS combined WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY "uploadDate" DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offSet}

mapper.update: UPDATE utb_file_mapp SET input_create_at = #{vo.inputCreateAt}, file_kind_code = #{vo.fileKindCode}, doc_seq = #{vo.docSeq}, note = #{vo.note}, update_user = #{vo.updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE office_seq = #{vo.officeSeq} AND tbl_seq = #{vo.tblSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM utb_file_mapp X WHERE X.file_mapp_seq = #{vo.fileMappSeq} AND X.office_seq = utb_file_mapp.office_seq AND X.tbl_seq = utb_file_mapp.tbl_seq AND X.doc_seq = utb_file_mapp.doc_seq AND X.file_kind_code = utb_file_mapp.file_kind_code AND COALESCE(X.note, '') = COALESCE(utb_file_mapp.note, '') AND (X.input_create_at = utb_file_mapp.input_create_at OR (X.input_create_at IS NULL AND utb_file_mapp.input_create_at IS NULL)) )
